entries.d6c442f2d0c1175b: To survive in the competitive sales environment of the food industry, the company is managing its business with a focus on establishing a supply system that puts safety and security first and building trust, speeding up product development and strengthening sales capabilities, forming a resilient management base through group-wide cost reduction and labor-saving and efficiency measures, and securing personnel through work style reform and personnel rotation. In frozen tofu, it will pursue dissemination of health-benefit information, development of products for different uses, and opening of overseas sales channels; in processed foods, it will differentiate itself through value-oriented new products; and it will continue to promote the growth of medical foodstuffs and foster new core businesses.
